scope: GP-v1 common-wire periodic/CRN contracts, bounded cost probe and conditional independent calibration; no confirmatory test
projection: 2 * sum(per-case maximum probe seconds / 24 * 400) * 12; sequential execution
baseline_selection: Minimum mean capped completion_time among ten simple candidates; ties mean totalUL+DL then case_id. Same candidate applied to all test worlds.
failed_missions: Keep completion_time=400, completed=false, found and all costs; software exceptions stop dependent stages and preserve rows
power_method: Normal approximation using paired calibration SD; maximum of observed SD and 95th percentile of 20000 bootstrap SDs; cost influence (pose - ratio*baseline)/mean(baseline); log-ratio SE scaling. Planning only, not guaranteed power from N=12.
negative_stop: If task gain <=0 and mean cost ratio>1.05 for either primary comparator: No-Go. N>200 or unknown/unstable variance/cost support: no feasible frozen confirmatory campaign.
assumptions: Fixed finite scenario, not measured hardware/PHY; candidate grid not a globally strongest baseline; GP-v1 not author-wire replay; no price sweep or generality claim
